record.question: Which place is known as the 'roof of the earth'?
record.explanation: Answer A: Pamir. The Pamir region is conventionally called the Roof of the World; among the printed choices it alone corresponds to roof of the earth. China's UNESCO tentative-list submission explicitly uses Roof of the World for the Pamirs. Historical/source note: Conventional geographical epithet, not a claim that every Pamir summit exceeds the Himalayas. Reference: https://whc.unesco.org/en/tentativelists/5535. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
